name: The Agency Gap
description: The widening divide between people who move with both direction and magnitude and people who drift. Because agency and its absence both compound, the gap grows from individual outcomes into a demographic, economic, cultural, and finally geopolitical force, one that averages conceal because the median describes drift while the tails build the future. The agency gap is not just a problem but a forecast.

links.label: The Agency Gap: Why Most People Stall, and Why a Few Move the World
